limitations: In-memory structural/corruption fixtures only; no model execution or real M4 result validation.
Synthetic zero-round/stride fixtures are metadata constructions, not measured trajectories.
Parent independently owns complete schedule, identity, checksum, and integration validation.
Version counters do not prove tensor snapshot immutability.
Request-reset and no-buffering flags are declarations; initial tensors and intermediate gradients are not serialized.
Final norms do not independently prove unchanged offline tensors, correct gradients, or exact generation distributions.
State bytes and bandwidth are algorithmic estimates, not hardware traffic.
